promptEs: Escuchá el acorde y elegí su calidad.
promptEn: Listen to the chord and choose its quality.
explanationEs: La♭-Do es tercera mayor y La♭-Mi quinta aumentada: es un La♭ aumentado. La quinta aumentada crea una tensión que lo separa de La♭ mayor, que tendría Mi♭.
explanationEn: A♭-C is a major third and A♭-E an augmented fifth: it is an A♭ augmented triad. The augmented fifth creates a tension that separates it from A♭ major, which would have E♭.
